text: A callback is a promise to a family that we'll check in. Working it from the task keeps the call, the notes and the chart entry in one place.
The one thing to remember: a callback is finished only when the conversation is filed to the chart.
Dr. Lane asked for this at the visit: how is Maple's leg?
Open Quo call dials Maria from Quo. When you hang up, the transcript comes back into this box.
You can also type what was said.
Clean up turns a long transcript into a short note. Read it over before you file it.
File this note to starts on Maple, so the call goes on Maple's chart as a communication note.
Staff notes stay on the task. They never reach the chart.
Can't finish it? Pick someone here and click Re-assign. The next person charts it.
This one's finished, so click Chart and complete.
Scout confirms the call is on Maple's chart, and the callback is done.

The most common mistakes: closing a callback without filing what was said, and filing a household's call to the wrong pet. Remember: a callback is finished only when the conversation is filed to the chart.
